T-001.Title: Honest file-icons notice: pinned license override in the node-notices generator, NOTICES-node.md regenerated in the same change

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tools/build-notices-node.mjs gains a pinned LICENSE_OVERRIDES map consulted after the license-checker license string is read, keyed "name@version" → {license, repository}, carrying exactly one entry: "file-icons@2.1.47" → MIT with repository https://github.com/file-icons/atom — sourced from package-lock.json:6666-6669, where the lockfile records "license": "MIT" for the pinned git+ssh revision whose installed metadata lacks a detectable license field. The override applies only to that exact name@version (a future real version bump re-enters normal detection), only rescues deps that license-checker lands in the UNLICENSED/UNKNOWN bucket, and changes nothing else: grouping, sorting, the self-package exclusion, header/footer and every other emitted byte stay identical. A code comment records the lockfile as the override source and the CI coupling: the committed NOTICES-node.md and this generator must move together because tools/verify-attributions.sh diffs them. Where the file header carries CHANGE_SUMMARY markup, add a dated 2026-11-21 line naming C-DOCS-SYNC.

NOTICES-node.md is regenerated with the overridden generator and committed in the same change — never hand-edited, never without the generator: file-icons 2.1.47 appears under the MIT section with the upstream repository URL; the "## UNLICENSED (1)" section and its "| UNLICENSED | 1 |" summary row disappear; the "## Unlicense (1)" robust-predicates section and every other row, section order and byte stay exactly as the pipeline emits, so verify-attributions' regeneration diff is clean.
